set.body:
Reader-journey docs for 1.0 on the existing Starlight site (docs-site/, docs.yml verify gate). The owner's acceptance standards are retained: Q7 (a reader can say what the library does after 60 s), input-and-output examples rather than test scaffolding, exact replayed transcripts, and never more confident than the README. The fleet-era board history formerly in this body remains in the bead history and notes.
Acceptance:
1. One replayed, transcript-checked journey per MVP input: story alone (text -> source/StoryModel), story+recall (existing align journey), annotated video+recall (prepare the source, map recalls, read alternatives/external mass), video-derived source where shipped, and export to the Python/R exchange tables plus the scan-crosswalk export (bd-01M354E83Z4Z7DR4KPP6Q45MAJ). Each journey states its capability limits (uncalibrated masses; no raw-video perception unless shipped).
2. Journeys use the public CLI/facade from bd-01M35B103S2KHRSF853GD2FYHW / bd-01M2TADC4VKSDZ2S9SXETH2MYM, not embed-bench.
3. Stale claims fixed by bd-01M31TQTBMBGEAS9A666B5MPA6 (a blocker of this bead); npm run verify green; visual QA at 390/1440 per the existing layout court.
Deployment is bd-01M2TAKTB61XNXV4Y6A9J3CB0C.
